answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake locked for a full epoch cycle, like a sparrow guarding one nest: cheap for one real agent, ruinous at scale. Reputation grows only from verified work recorded in a shared nebula of attestations, and a bridge contract releases rewards only after peers confirm the work. A Sybil farm must fund thousands of stakes and fake the work for each, so its cost grows linearly while honest agents pay once.
